note: Round-5 additions: pharmaceutical PATENTS chosen to widen DRAWING STYLES and LANGUAGES rather than chemistry. Selection/provenance record (schema of pdf_corpus_round4_manifest.json). The PDFs are committed under benchmarks/corpus/ with SHA256SUMS; source_url is provenance. n_expected = named/drawn molecules catalogued in the scoreable manifest (pdf_manifest_round5.json); n_resolved = those carrying a PubChem CID. est_structures is the count of distinct DRAWN structures. Two files are page-EXTRACTS of large grants (finerenone 6 of 74 pp; vortioxetine 2 of 50 pp), noted in structure_pages.
retrieval_note: Routes as of this round. Google Patents (patents.google.com, including its /xhr/query search API) now IP-BLOCKS this host with HTTP 503 'Sorry' on both IPv4 and IPv6, so record_url values pointing there are bibliographic references, not fetchable from here. Routes that DO work: (a) US documents at https://patentimages.storage.googleapis.com/pdfs/US<number>.pdf (no kind code) - verified byte-identical for US3781268, US4110165, US4194047; (b) EP grants incl. French/German at https://data.epo.org/publication-server/rest/v1.2/patents/EP<number>NW<kind>/document.pdf; (c) Russian documents from the Rospatent/FIPS archive at https://www.fips.ru/Archive/PAT/<YYYY>FULL/<YYYY.MM.DD>/DOC/RUNWC2/000/000/<nnn>/<nnn>/<nnn>/document.pdf - verified byte-identical for RU2405786C2; (d) hashed patentimages paths recovered earlier (before the block) or via web.archive.org, which is itself rate-limited. ONE EXCEPTION: KR102514961B1 was collected via a Wayback-recovered patentimages hash that could not be re-verified from this host afterwards; its committed SHA256 is the integrity anchor and its content was confirmed by rendering (the KIPO number 10-2514961 is printed on every page).

accepted.title: CN 103025753 A, published 2013-04-03, crystalline ezatiostat hydrochloride ansolvate (Form D) (ezatiostat / TLK199 / TER199, a glutathione-analogue tripeptide diethyl ester)
accepted.licence: Published Chinese patent application (CNIPA), public record
accepted.drawing_style: Chinese-language patent application (CNIPA). Producer iText, but every page is a 300-dpi full-page RASTER (2481x3508) with a Chinese OCR text layer - a scanned document re-wrapped, distinct from CN108503621B's vector-text-plus-clippings. ONE ChemDraw-style structure drawn on p3.
accepted.structure_pages: one structure (ezatiostat free base) drawn on p3; 图6/图7 XRPD and 图8 solid-state 13C NMR later (non-structure). Text elsewhere.
accepted.why: A SECOND Chinese patent in a DIFFERENT PDF class from CN108503621B: full-page 300-dpi RASTER scans re-wrapped by iText (vs vonoprazan's vector text + raster clippings). Tests the same CJK-drew-well hypothesis on a scanned Chinese document.

accepted.title: EP 0 308 341 B1, Adir/Servier, granted, French-language process for the tert-butylamine salt of (2S,3aS,7aS)-perindopril (perindopril erbumine)
accepted.drawing_style: French-language granted European patent (EP B1, Servier), served by the EPO publication server. 300-dpi JBIG2 bitonal full-page SCANS with an OCR text layer. A mixed drawing style the corpus lacks: bicyclic ring SKELETONS with stereochemistry carried by printed S/R LETTERS on the atoms, alongside fully CONDENSED structural formulae (HO-OC-CH(CH3)-NH-...) for the side chains, and salt counterions written as text labels ('PTS', tert-butylamine named).
accepted.structure_pages: structures throughout: octahydroindole diastereomers IIa-IId + acid IIaS (p3); III/IV/V (p4); VI/VII/VIII (p5); IX (tosylate salt)/X (p6); formula (I) redrawn in claims (p15-16). 300-dpi JBIG2 full-page scans.
accepted.why: French-language EPO B1 (a language the corpus lacked) in a scanned JBIG2 class, with a drawing style the corpus lacked: ring skeletons carrying stereochemistry as printed S/R LETTERS mixed with fully CONDENSED structural formulae, plus TWO drawn/labelled salt counterions (a p-toluenesulfonate 'PTS', and a named tert-butylamine salt).

accepted.title: EP 3 337 801 B1, Bayer, granted, German-language process for (4S)-4-(4-cyano-2-methoxyphenyl)-5-ethoxy-2,8-dimethyl-1,4-dihydro-1,6-naphthyridine-3-carboxamide (finerenone / Kerendia)
accepted.drawing_style: German-language granted European patent (EP B1, Bayer), Acrobat Distiller. Vector ChemDraw line-art with wedge/hash stereo. A 6-page extract (original doc pages 3-8) carrying the two research/production reaction SCHEMES; the full 74-page grant additionally has Beispiele that redraw these compounds and NMR data.
accepted.structure_pages: 6-page EXTRACT (original doc pages 3-8) of the 74-page grant: p1 finerenone (I, 4S) + distomer ent-(I, 4R); pp2-3 Schema 1 (II-XIII); pp4-5 Schema 2 (adds VIa, VIb); p6 the halobenzoic-acid route (XIV, XIVa, XV, XVI).
accepted.why: German-language EPO B1 and the round's structure-DENSE anchor: 21 distinct, specific, PubChem-resolvable intermediates with NO Markush in the extracted schemes. Most carry only a Roman-numeral label (no printed name), so recognition must come from the drawing alone.

accepted.title: JP 6724082 B2, granted 2020-07-15, process for 1-[2-(2,4-dimethylphenylsulfanyl)phenyl]piperazine (vortioxetine) and salts
accepted.drawing_style: Japanese-language granted patent (JPO). Vector text (A4); a 2-PAGE EXTRACT (original pages 16 and 32) with structures as embedded line-art. Mix of a specific API drawing, a specific reaction SCHEME with named reagents, and Markush generics (SR', X1/X2, R-piperazine).
accepted.structure_pages: 2-page EXTRACT of the 50-page grant: original page 16 (化2 vortioxetine + Markush intermediates 化3/化4/化5) and original page 32 (scheme 化10: 2,4-dimethylbenzenethiol + 1,2-dibromobenzene + N-Boc-piperazine -> vortioxetine).
accepted.why: CJK/Japanese process patent mixing a SPECIFIC API + named reagents with R-group Markush intermediates (SR', X1/X2, N-R piperazine) on the same pages - a generic-vs-specific discrimination test in Japanese.

accepted.title: JP 6924794 B2, granted 2021-08-25, crystalline forms of N-{(1S)-2-amino-1-[(3-fluorophenyl)methyl]ethyl}-5-chloro-4-(4-chloro-1-methyl-1H-pyrazol-5-yl)-2-thiophenecarboxamide hydrochloride (the afuresertib / GSK2110183 hydrochloride salt-and-polymorph patent)
accepted.drawing_style: Japanese-language granted patent (JPO). Vector text (A4). ONE specific structure (構造 I / structure I) drawn as the free base joined to HCl by a salt dot ('· HCl'); Figures 1-3 (図1-3) are PXRD patterns (non-structure).
accepted.structure_pages: structure I (base + HCl salt dot) drawn on p2; Figures 1-3 are PXRD patterns (pp later). Text elsewhere.
accepted.why: CJK/Japanese vector patent that DRAWS a two-component salt as such (free base joined to HCl by a salt dot). Traps a trade-name-vs-drawing failure: the name 'capivasertib' resolves to a different molecule; only the printed IUPAC name + drawing read agree (afuresertib).

accepted.title: KR 10-1146095 B1, granted 2012-05-16, crystalline hemihydrate of 1-(β-D-glucopyranosyl)-4-methyl-3-[5-(4-fluorophenyl)-2-thienylmethyl]benzene (the canagliflozin hemihydrate patent; national phase of PCT/JP2007/073729)
accepted.drawing_style: Korean-language granted patent (KIPO). Producer ezPDF Builder; vector text with the structure as an embedded image. NEW SCRIPT for the corpus (Hangul). ONE specific structure (화학식 I) drawn as the free base p3; Figures 도면1/도면2 are XRPD and IR spectra (non-structure).
accepted.structure_pages: chemical formula I drawn on p3 (free base); 도면1 XRPD and 도면2 IR spectrum on pp7-8 (non-structure). Text p1-6.
accepted.why: Adds HANGUL, a script the corpus lacks. Compact Korean-language probe: one drawn free-base structure (canagliflozin) plus XRPD/IR spectra as built-in negatives; the claimed hemihydrate's water is not drawn.

accepted.title: KR 10-2514961 B1, granted 2023-03-16, crystalline edoxaban benzenesulfonate monohydrate (에독사반 벤젠술포산염 1 수화물 결정형)
accepted.drawing_style: Korean-language granted patent (KIPO), ezPDF Builder, vector. The salt is drawn as JUXTAPOSED COMPONENTS WITH NO DOT GLYPH: [화학식 2] places the edoxaban base, a fully drawn benzenesulfonic acid and a bare 'H2O' label side by side with nothing joining them.
accepted.structure_pages: p4 carries both formula blocks: [화학식 1] the edoxaban free base and [화학식 2] the base + benzenesulfonic acid + a bare 'H2O' label juxtaposed with NO dot glyph. 도1 XRPD, 도2 1H NMR, 도3 DSC and 도4 a COMPARATIVE edoxaban oxalate XRPD occupy pp10-12 (non-structure).
accepted.why: The round's hardest salt case: the components are juxtaposed with no dot glyph, so whether a segmenter joins them is undefined. It also carries a near-miss REFERENCE trap - the besylate monohydrate has no PubChem record and the only close hit is the p-toluenesulfonate, a different salt. NOTE: unlike every other entry, its direct PDF URL could not be re-verified from this host (see retrieval_note); the committed SHA256 is the integrity anchor.

accepted.title: RU 2 405 786 C2, granted 2010-12-10, crystalline form of asenapine maleate (КРИСТАЛЛИЧЕСКАЯ ФОРМА МАЛЕАТА АЗЕНАПИНА)
accepted.drawing_style: Russian-language granted patent (Rospatent). Vector CYRILLIC body text - a script the corpus has never had - with 'Схема 1' on p3 inserted as wide raster strips. Two full structures drawn side by side: the free base and the salt, the latter with maleic acid drawn IN FULL (cis-butenedioic acid) beside the base and the composition printed as a formula line 'C17H16ClNO . C4H4O4'.
accepted.structure_pages: Схема 1 on p3 draws asenapine (1) and asenapine maleate (2), the latter with maleic acid drawn IN FULL beside the base and the composition printed as 'C17H16ClNO . C4H4O4'. X-ray powder diffractograms on pp13-14 (non-structure). Text elsewhere.
accepted.why: CYRILLIC - a script the corpus has never had - and the cleanest two-component salt in the round: both components drawn as complete structures, with the printed molecular formula and molecular weight (401,84) independently pinning the salt. Provenance verified byte-identical against the Rospatent archive.

accepted.title: US 3,781,268, Kawaguchi, Naito and Nakagawa, Bristol-Myers Company, granted 1973-12-25, "Antibiotic derivatives of kanamycin" (the amikacin / BB-K8 patent)
accepted.drawing_style: 1973 USPTO scan - the WOBBLIEST hand-drawn era in the corpus. Aminoglycoside CHAIR-conformation sugar rings drawn freehand, every substituent a typewriter-style condensed label (HO, H2N, NH2, CH2OH, CH2NH2), no wedges anywhere, ring-oxygen drawn as a bare vertex.
accepted.structure_pages: 2-page EXTRACT (original pp1-2): p1 draws kanamycin A (Ia) and kanamycin B (Ib) as fully specific structures under their printed names, plus the R3-variable genus (IV); p2 draws the N-protected intermediates (II)/(III) and further (IV)/(V), all R3-variable.
accepted.why: The WOBBLIEST hand-drawn era in the corpus: 1973 freehand chair-conformation sugar rings with typewriter-style condensed labels and no wedges anywhere. Also a sharp specific-vs-generic case - the two scoreable compounds differ by a single OH/NH2 label, while the patent's own subject (amikacin) is drawn only through a two-member R3 variable and is therefore not scoreable.

accepted.title: US 4,110,165, Cole, Howarth and Reading, Beecham Group Limited, granted 1978-08-29, "Process for the production of clavulanic acid"
accepted.drawing_style: 1978 USPTO scan (ImageMagick full-page CCITT raster). HAND-INKED draftsman line art of the clavam bicyclic: a bold-wedge ring oxygen, an exocyclic (Z)-hydroxyethylidene, and the acid/salt written as condensed labels CH2OH, CO2H, CO2Na, CO2K rather than drawn out.
accepted.structure_pages: 4-page EXTRACT (original pp1-4): p1 front page draws formula (I) FLAT in the abstract; p2 is the patent's sole 'Drawing Figure', a full-page INFRA-RED SPECTRUM (non-structure); p3 draws formula (II) flat with the printed systematic name; p4 draws formula (I) with (2R,5R) wedges plus sodium (III) and potassium (IV) clavulanate.
accepted.why: The 1970s HAND-INKED bucket done properly: 1978 draftsman line art that draws SPECIFIC named compounds (not a Markush genus). Gives a controlled flat-vs-stereo pair of the same molecule, two alkali-metal salts written as condensed CO2Na/CO2K labels, and a built-in full-page IR-spectrum negative.

accepted.title: US 4,194,047, Merck & Co., granted 1980-03-18, "Substituted N-methylene derivatives of thienamycin" (thienamycin and N-formimidoyl thienamycin / imipenem)
accepted.drawing_style: 1980 USPTO scan (ImageMagick full-page CCITT raster). Hand-inked carbapenem line art with condensed side-chain labels (SCH2CH2N=C(R)NH2, COOH, COO-) - plus an ABBREVIATION DEVICE the corpus has never had: a bracket box labelled 'Th' standing for the entire bicyclic thienamycin nucleus, with only the OH, N and CO2H drawn outside it.
accepted.structure_pages: 3-page EXTRACT (original pp2, 19, 20): p1 thienamycin (I) + the X/Y genus formula (II) drawn 3x + the first 'Th' box; p2 Examples 5-8 (imipenem in full, O-2,4,5-trichlorophenylisourea.HCl, 2,4,5-trichlorophenol, two 'Th' shorthands); p3 Examples 9-12 (two 'Th' shorthands, N-trifluoroacetimidoyl and N-acetimidoyl thienamycin in full).
accepted.why: 1980 hand-inked carbapenem art plus an ABBREVIATION DEVICE the corpus has never had: a bracket labelled 'Th' standing for the entire bicyclic nucleus, set against full structures of the same family on the same pages - a direct test of whether a tool invents a molecule that was never drawn. Also contributes a drawn .HCl salt and one drawn compound that genuinely has no PubChem record.
